title: Wayfare Pass Membership Terms — Loyalty Correction Relief on Ride Credit
content:
# Loyalty correction relief (Wayfare Pass)

**Clause.** When Pass ride credit is clawed back from a Wayfare Pass (rider membership) member because a fare was reduced by a fare adjustment, the loyalty correction relief is 50 percent for a member who has held the membership for at least 24 whole months and has had no credit correction or forfeiture on a trip in the last 12 months; it is 25 percent for a member who does not meet that tier but has held the membership for at least 12 whole months and has had at most one such entry in the last 12 months; it is nothing for anyone else.

**Effect.** The relief takes that percentage of the clawed-back credit on the trip off the credit correction. The percentage is of the clawed-back credit itself; the credit correction never goes below 0.00, and it is rounded half up to the cent once the relief is taken off.

## Terms used

- **Whole months held**: whole calendar months from the membership's enrollment date to the date the correction is booked.
- **Credit correction or forfeiture on a trip**: a credit forfeiture entry of the trip-refund kind on the membership ledger, dated in the last 12 months.

## Tier table

| Whole months held | Trip-refund forfeitures in the last 12 months | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or more | none | 50 percent |
| 24 or more | exactly one | 25 percent |
| 12 to 23 | none or one | 25 percent |
| 12 or more | two or more | nothing |
| under 12 | any | nothing |

## Edges and a figure (hypothetical)

- 24 months, none: 50 percent; 23 months, none: 25 percent.
- 12 months, one: 25 percent; 11 months, none: nothing; 40 months, two: nothing.
- With 0.36 clawed back and the 50 percent tier, 0.18 is taken off, leaving a correction of 0.18.
